    A supervised K–2 prototype · No API key needed

    FOR THE GROWN-UPS

    A little room for curiosity.

    My Lesson Buddy combines a character studio and a worksheet-to-cartoon lesson maker. Everything visitors create is processed on their own device; this site does not upload their pictures to our server.

    What works in this prototype

    Build or draw a character, choose or photograph one question, review its interpretation, and play or download a narrated story. Your character collects, carries, and shares original worksheet pictures, visits objects to count them, and traces a shape gate. Photos can be cropped, straightened, and light-corrected on this device, with the original kept for comparison. Review every cutout and quantity before playing; story stars are an optional fallback. Supported topics are addition, subtraction, counting, and circles, triangles, squares, and rectangles, with quantities through 10.

    About the optional AI reader

    The pretrained SmolVLM 256M model downloads from Hugging Face when you choose to use it. It needs a WebGPU-compatible browser and enough device memory. It is experimental, smaller than our Mac reader, and may miscount. In our first browser tests it could not reliably interpret the included popsicle worksheet. Entering or correcting a question always works without that model.

    Keeping children’s work

    Characters are saved in this browser’s storage. Other visitors do not see them. Download a character package to keep a backup or use another device; clearing browser data removes locally saved work. The AI model may remain in the browser’s cache until browser data is cleared.

    Sound & video

    Narration clips are provided with the site. No microphone, paid voice API, or account is required. Video export depends on browser recording support; Chrome and Edge are recommended for the first prototype. A desktop browser is best for the AI reader. Keep the page open during recording.

    This prototype supports exploration with a grown-up. It has not been evaluated for learning outcomes.
